differences: The paper (and the Zenodo description) states eleven subjects, but virtual_glove.rar holds 20 files = 10 subjects x 2 sensors: the authors' subject numbers run 1 to 8, 10 and 11, subject 9 has no Leap Motion files, so this release has 10 persons, not 11. The deposit does not say why.
The paper does not state the sensor frame rate, units or axis definitions, so none of them could be checked against it.
